seo.description: Leaders International School (LIS), also known as Leaders School Zanzibar, is a premier co-educational pre-primary and primary school located in Kisakasaka, Zanzibar. Offering dual NECTA (Tanzanian national) and Cambridge International curricula from Baby Class through Grade 6 / Year 6. Official website: leaderinternationalschool.ac.tz.

hero.title: Shaping Future
hero.lead: At Leaders International School (LIS) — also known as Leaders School Zanzibar — we provide a world-class education that empowers children to excel academically, grow as global citizens, and lead with integrity, from Baby Class & Nursery through Grade 6 / Year 6 across our NECTA and Cambridge wings in Kisakasaka.
hero.imageAlt: LIS learners of many backgrounds in cream and sky-blue uniforms, reading together in a colourful classroom

features.title: Dual Curriculum Wings
features.text: Choose between the Tanzanian national (NECTA) curriculum and Cambridge Assessment International Education (Years 1–6).

features.title: Experienced Teachers
features.text: Dedicated and passionate educators committed to nurturing every learner's academic and personal growth.

features.title: Modern Facilities
features.text: Bright classrooms, science & ICT labs, a 640-title library, shaded assembly veranda, and daily breakfast & lunch on campus.

features.title: Holistic Development
features.text: Daily other curriculum & values education, robotics, arts, sports, and public speaking woven into the school week.

whyUs.title: Why families choose LIS
whyUs.intro: Every child is known by name, tracked carefully, and supported by class teachers who partner closely with parents.

points.title: Small classes, real attention
points.text: A maximum of 24 learners per primary room and 18 in Pre-Primary with two adults, so every child gets daily individual feedback.

points.title: NECTA & Cambridge wings on one campus
points.text: Families can choose the Tanzanian national curriculum (Grades 1–6) or the Cambridge Primary International stream (Years 1–6) under one roof.

points.title: Hands-on science & computing
points.text: Practical science experiments, computer literacy, and coding lessons every week — children learn by doing, not just copying from a board.

points.title: All-inclusive monthly fee plan
points.text: Annual fees are payable in 12 equal monthly instalments and already include tuition, stationery, breakfast & hot lunch, caution fee, and other curriculum.

points.title: One uniform, strong values & safeguarding
points.text: Cream polo with sky-blue trim, navy bottoms, daily other curriculum and moral reflection, and a strict child-protection policy.

points.title: Leadership from the earliest years
points.text: Morning assembly presentations, reading buddies, debate, robotics, and sports help shy pupils grow into confident speakers.

points.title: Safe transport across Urban West
points.text: Monitored school bus routes across Kisakasaka, Kombeni, and Stone Town corridors with a female attendant on every vehicle.

testimonials.quote: My daughter arrived shy in Grade 2. Within a year she led the Founder's Day assembly in both English and Swahili. The teachers at LIS truly build confidence.
testimonials.name: Asha Msigwa

testimonials.quote: Moving our son into the Cambridge Wing at LIS was the best decision we made. Having breakfast, lunch, stationery, and other curriculum included in one monthly instalment makes planning so easy for parents.
testimonials.name: Hamad Salim

testimonials.quote: What I value most is the communication. If something happens at school I hear about it the same day, not at the end of term.
testimonials.name: Grace Juma

testimonials.quote: Both my boys love the coding and science fair projects here. They wake up excited for school every single morning.
testimonials.name: Rashid Mohamed

cta.title: Give your child a school that knows their name
cta.text: Admissions for the January 2027 intake (2026/2027 academic year) are open across Baby Class, Nursery (KG1 & KG2), NECTA Grades 1–6, and Cambridge Years 1–6.
